notes: Claude can now add design effects (neon, 3D extrude, glow…) and one-click Looks to your design.
Saving and the saved-files browser keep working while Claude is thinking.
Updates are safer offline: an update only installs once every file has downloaded.
Drawing tools now remind you to press V to select things again.
Fixed the folder name shown when saving to your assets library.
Behind the scenes: tidier code and automatic checks before every release.
